name: John James

statements.title: JIHADI VIOLENCE IN NIGERIA
sentences: We will not continue to fund a Christian genocide.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SECURING AMERICA'S CRITICAL MINERALS SUPPLY ACT
statements.title: SECURING AMERICA'S CRITICAL MINERALS SUPPLY ACT
sentences: Russia maintains roughly 44 percent of the world's uranium enrichment capacity and supplies a significant share of nuclear fuel imports to the United States.
We are the solution, and we will continue to lead.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to join me in unleashing the full potential of America's energy might.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AFFORDABLE HOUSING OVER MANDATING EFFICIENCY STANDARDS ACT
statements.title: AFFORDABLE HOUSING OVER MANDATING EFFICIENCY STANDARDS ACT
sentences: Now, after 4 years of Bidenflation, which saw home costs double, Michigan Democrats are pushing new building codes, expecting to add another $15,000 to the cost of a new home.

Through efforts like my Path to Affordable Homes Act and the important legislation that Congresswoman Houchin introduced today, we are working to cut unnecessary regulatory barriers, expand housing affordability, and ensure families, seniors, and future generations have a fair shot at homeownership and building generational wealth.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support H.R. 5184.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: OBAMACARE ISN'T WORKING
statements.title: OBAMACARE ISN'T WORKING
sentences: Mr. Speaker, today I rise for the families in my district and across America who are getting crushed by medical bills they never saw coming.
What we got instead was the most expensive healthcare system on the Earth with hospitals and insurance companies cashing in while working families foot the bill.
In the last 25 years, medical costs have gone up over 121 percent, and since ObamaCare passed, healthcare spending has exploded another 60-plus percent.
Her family of four is staring at a $40,000 bill because of a medical emergency under the so-called Affordable Care Act.
That is the ACA in a nutshell: You are in trouble if you are healthy, and you are really in trouble if you get sick.

In literally every part of life elsewhere, buying a car, groceries, or a cell phone, you know the price before you swipe your card and before you put your hard-earned cash on the register, Mr. Speaker.
Then they send you a bill that ruins your life and puts you in debt.
While hospitals and insurance companies rake in record profits, American families are drowning in medical debt, more medical debt than credit cards, car loans, and everything else combined.
For the first time, they will have to publicly post their real rates and drug prices, too.
That is why I introduced the Patients Deserve Price Tags Act.
I am asking every one of my colleagues to join our bipartisan bill, Republican and Democrat, to stand with the families getting hammered by these bills.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MARKING A NATIONAL MILESTONE
statements.title: MARKING A NATIONAL MILESTONE
sentences: It requires our schools to identify and support students who need services, including children experiencing homelessness and those attending private schools.
As we honor IDEA's 50th anniversary, I am proud to introduce the IDEAL Act, a bill that fully funds and strengthens the original IDEA program.
I urge my colleagues to support the IDEAL Act. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORT FOR PATIENTS AND COMMUNITIES REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SUPPORT FOR PATIENTS AND COMMUNITIES REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
sentences: We cannot allow this poison to continue tearing our families apart, and I am proud the House Republicans are, once again, leading the fight to protect our communities and get fentanyl off our streets.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RELATING TO "CALIFORNIA STATE MOTOR VEHICLE AND ENGINE POLLUTION CO
statements.title: PROVIDING CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RELATING TO "CALIFORNIA STATE MOTOR VEHICLE AND ENGINE POLLUTION CONTROL STANDARDS; HEAVY-DUTY...
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise to speak in support of H.J. Res. 87, my resolution of disapproval to overturn the Biden administration's California Advanced Clean Trucks rule.
Let's talk about lowering prescription drug costs.
I wonder how many American lives they would sacrifice on the altar of their Green New Deal initiatives.
In addition to air pollution, Republicans care about clean air.
It is a Green New Deal mandate that will crush our trucking industry and drive costs up on everything and increase deaths on our highways.

Today, the House of Representatives will send a resounding ``no'' to the radical left and a resounding ``yes'' to the middle class, to our job creators, to our employers, and to our truckers who keep America running.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to do simple math, use common sense, and put this Biden-era California waiver to bed once and for all.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROMOTING RESILIENT SUPPLY CHAINS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PROMOTING RESILIENT SUPPLY CHAINS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, we must do everything in our power to ensure that our Nation's supply chain is resilient, shock resistant, and protected from nefarious foreign adversaries; this includes the Chinese Communist Party.

This legislation specifically will create a supply chain resiliency program to identify and address gaps in critical industries and emerging technologies, establish an early warning system to predict and prevent supply chain disruption, and reduce dependence on adversarial nations by incentivizing domestic manufacturing.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of my bill, H.R. 2444, the Promoting Resilient Supply Chains Act of 2025.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to join me in supporting this legislation, H.R. 2444, the Promoting Resilient Supply Chains Act of 2025.
